`final class FontFamily<F extends IFontFace>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.glyph` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FontFamily.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/glyph/FontFamily.java)

The faces of one font, by weight and style, from which a text picks the face it draws with.

## Description

A [`GlyphFont`](/reference/text/glyphfont/) holds one family; [`MsdfFontLoader`](/reference/text/msdffontloader/) builds it for you from the files you load.

## Creation details

<a id="FontFamily-factory-of"></a>

### of

`<F extends IFontFace> FontFamily<F> of(F... faces)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: A font family needs at least one face, got none: pass its faces to FontFamily.of(...)
- `IllegalArgumentException`: Two faces share the weight …, keep one face per weight and style

Creates a family of `faces`, sorted by weight.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when no face is given or when two faces share a weight and a style.

## Method details

<a id="FontFamily-method-resolve"></a>

### resolve

`F resolve(FontWeight weight, boolean italic)` 

Returns the face for `weight` and `italic`: among the faces of that style, or all faces when none has it, the closest weight.
For a requested weight of 400 or above 500, the heavier of two equally close faces wins; otherwise the lighter one.
A weight that the family does not have warns once in dev mode and names the loaded faces.

<a id="FontFamily-method-getFaces"></a>

### getFaces

`List<F> getFaces()` 

Returns the faces, sorted by weight, as a list you cannot change.
